role: GDP Responsible Person reviewing customer returns held in the warehouse quarantine cage
setting: A licensed pharmaceutical wholesale warehouse receives returned stock from pharmacies and hospitals. Each return is booked into a locked quarantine location and must be dispositioned before its hold limit. The Responsible Person opens one return record at a time. They compare the customer's claim, the original dispatch, the physical inspection, unique-identifier scans, temperature evidence and the customer's storage compliance, then decide what happens to the stock.

storage_maintained.instructions: Stock stayed within labelled storage conditions while away from the warehouse.

batch_traceable.instructions: Every counted pack belongs to a batch originally dispatched to this customer.

criteria.true: Each counted batch appears on the linked dispatch.
criteria.false: A counted batch is missing from dispatch, or no dispatch is linked.

next_step.instructions: What should happen to this quarantined return now?

criteria.release_stock: All packs pass every check; return them to saleable stock.
criteria.request_evidence: One named document is missing; obtain it before deciding.
criteria.partial_release: Release sound packs; send failed or short-dated packs for destruction.
criteria.reject_destroy: No pack is resaleable; book the whole return for destruction.
criteria.escalate_qp: Unexplained authenticity or traceability failure; refer to the Qualified Person.

resaleable_share.instructions: What share of counted packs is fit for saleable stock?
criteria: No counted pack is fit for resale
Fewer than half of counted packs fit
Half or more, but not all, fit
Every counted pack fit for resale

disposition_urgency.instructions: How soon must this return be dispositioned before its hold limit?
criteria: Routine: more than 20 days remain before hold limit
Planned: 10 to 20 days remain before limit
Prompt: 4 to 9 days remain before limit
Urgent: 0 to 3 days remain before limit
Overdue: effective hold limit already passed

factors.name: storage_class
factors.description: Labelled storage requirement of the product: ambient up to 25°C, or refrigerated 2–8°C. This sets which temperature evidence is needed.

factors.name: logger_coverage
factors.description: Whether the temperature logger window spans the period from customer delivery to warehouse receipt, leaves a gap at either end, or is absent.

factors.name: excursion_minutes
factors.description: Cumulative minutes the logged readings sat outside the labelled range. Values below 30 are rendered as 0.

factors.name: stability_allowance_on_file
factors.description: Mitigation: a manufacturer stability statement is on file that tolerates excursions up to a stated duration and temperature.

factors.name: batch_reconciliation
factors.description: How counted batch and expiry compare with the original dispatch lines: exact; same batch with expiry in a different format; one line with a batch never dispatched to this customer; or no dispatch reference found.

factors.name: count_discrepancy_packs
factors.description: Difference between packs claimed on the customer return note and packs physically counted, spread across one or more lines.

factors.name: damaged_pack_fraction
factors.description: Share of counted packs with broken anti-tamper seals, crushed cartons or pharmacy labels attached.

factors.name: uid_alert
factors.description: Alarming signal: at least one pack's unique identifier scan returns a decommissioned or unknown status at verification.

factors.name: uid_alert_explained
factors.description: Mitigation for a scan alert: the decommission event was made at this customer's own site within 10 days, so the pack is eligible for reactivation.

factors.name: days_out_of_control
factors.description: Days between delivery to the customer and receipt back at the warehouse, compared against the policy maximum for saleable returns.

factors.name: customer_audit_current
factors.description: Mitigation: the customer site holds an in-date storage audit and a signed storage declaration covering this return.

factors.name: quarantine_days_remaining
factors.description: Days from review date to the original hold limit (received date plus hold limit days). Negative means the limit has passed.

factors.name: hold_extension_approved
factors.description: Mitigation: an approved hold extension moves the effective limit to a later date.

factors.name: shelf_life_months_remaining
factors.description: Months from review date to the counted pack expiry, compared with the minimum remaining shelf life required for saleable stock.

sections.name: return_header
sections.description: Return id, customer site, delivered_at, received_at, review_date, reason code, and claimed lines with qty_claimed.

sections.name: dispatch_ref
sections.description: Original dispatch number and date, with lines of gtin, batch, expiry and qty_dispatched; null if unlinked.

sections.name: inspection
sections.description: Counted lines with gtin, batch, expiry, qty_counted, packs_damaged and seals_intact, plus a list of uid_scans with status and event details.

sections.name: temperature
sections.description: Storage class, labelled range, logger id, logger_start and logger_end, min_c, max_c, minutes_out_of_range, and a stability_ref (null if none).

sections.name: customer_compliance
sections.description: Last storage audit date, audit_valid_until, and whether a storage declaration was received for this return.

sections.name: quarantine_control
sections.description: Location, hold_limit_days, extension object, max_days_out_of_control and min_shelf_life_months policy values.

rendering_notes: storage_class appears in temperature.storage_class and temperature.labelled_range. logger_coverage is never stated; the reader must compare logger_start and logger_end with return_header.delivered_at and received_at. A gap shows as a start after delivery or an end before receipt; absent means logger_id, logger_start and logger_end are null. excursion_minutes appears as temperature.minutes_out_of_range, alongside min_c and max_c that sit outside or inside the labelled range consistently. stability_allowance_on_file appears as temperature.stability_ref, an object with max_hours and max_c, or null. batch_reconciliation is shown only by comparing inspection line batch and expiry with dispatch_ref lines. expiry_format_only renders as the same batch with expiry written as month-year on one side and a full date on the other. no_dispatch_link renders dispatch_ref as null. count_discrepancy_packs is split across lines as differences between return_header claimed qty_claimed and inspection qty_counted. damaged_pack_fraction is rendered as per-line packs_damaged and seals_intact counts. uid_alert appears as one or more inspection.uid_scans entries with status 'decommissioned' or 'unknown'. uid_alert_explained adds decommission_site matching the customer site id and a decommission_at within 10 days of review_date; otherwise the site is different or null. days_out_of_control must be computed from delivered_at and received_at against quarantine_control.max_days_out_of_control. customer_audit_current appears as audit_valid_until on or after review_date plus declaration_received true. quarantine_days_remaining is computed from received_at plus hold_limit_days against review_date. hold_extension_approved appears as extension {approved: true, new_limit_date}, which replaces the original limit; otherwise approved is false and new_limit_date is null. shelf_life_months_remaining is computed from counted expiry against review_date and min_shelf_life_months. Decoys: return_reason_code (for example ORDER_ERROR, OVERSTOCK, DAMAGED_IN_TRANSIT) does not decide anything, and a damage reason code may come with intact packs. quarantine_location codes, logger battery level, and an extra matching dispatch line for a product not returned are also decoys. Mismatches are never flagged. No field may state resaleability, urgency, disposition, risk or a pass/fail verdict.
